site.pageTitle: Upcycle Compass · A second life for food by-products
site.imageAlt: Food ingredients, peanuts and almonds in ceramic bowls on a sunlit stone surface.
site.heroDescription: Today's by-product could be tomorrow's ingredient. We help you explore that possibility — with science, transparency, and a clear next step.
site.heroFootnote: Built for better decisions. Rooted in food science.
site.resultCaption: Explore a sample in the prototype
site.audienceEyebrow: A COMPASS FOR THE PEOPLE MOVING FOOD FORWARD
site.whatItalic: We help you find a path.
site.whatDescription: We turn a complex ingredient question into an evidence-led exploration: what could work, what stands in the way, and what to do next.
site.feature1Description: Evaluate sunflower cake for Protein Rich Flour; compare other oilseed references and pea isolate without hiding research gaps.
site.feature2Description: Understand safety gates, protein potential, and processing options. See the source and uncertainty behind each number.
site.feature3Description: Compare treatment chains and costs, then find the lab test that could most improve your decision.
site.missionBandDescription: A more circular food system starts with a better question: what value is already here, and what evidence do we need to unlock it?
site.missionBandCaption: LOCAL MATERIALS. THOUGHTFUL SCIENCE. SHARED POSSIBILITY.
site.viewProcess: A closer look at the process
site.step1Description: Choose a sample or describe your batch. Tell the Compass what you have and what you want to make.
site.step2Description: Review the verdict, safety checks, treatment options, and cost comparison. Look closer at any number.
site.step3Description: Find the next useful lab test. Add real results, revisit the analysis, and take a decision memo with you.
site.evidenceDescription: An estimate should never look like a measurement. Our evidence labels make the difference visible, so you can see both the potential and the gaps.

evidence.measuredDescription: From your batch or a laboratory result.
evidence.assumedDescription: An explicit estimate or transferred value.
evidence.syntheticDescription: A demo placeholder, not a measurement.

site.ctaEyebrow: YOUR NEXT INGREDIENT STORY STARTS HERE
site.ctaNote: No account needed. Start with a sample.
site.aboutIntro: We are the team behind Upcycle Compass: a research-informed prototype exploring how food by-products could become useful local protein ingredients.
site.whoDescription: Built for Hack the Fork 2026, Upcycle Compass brings food-science evidence and transparent decision modelling into one practical exploration tool.
site.whoDescription2: We are building for the mill owner with a by-product, the food innovator looking for a local ingredient, and the researcher asking what needs to be tested. We believe better conversations begin when everyone can inspect the evidence.
site.originTitle: Made with a real-world question in mind
site.originDescription: Hack the Fork 2026 · India Edition · Proof of concept
site.belief1Description: A promising material is a starting point. Safety checks, lab evidence, and the intended use must guide what happens next.
site.belief2Description: We show assumptions and missing inputs. An honest “test first” can be more useful than a confident answer the evidence cannot support.
site.belief3Description: A decision should lead somewhere: a processing option to investigate, a cost to question, or a lab test to commission.
site.aboutEvidence: The deterministic engine produces the numbers. Optional AI helps explain them, with a template fallback. AI-written explanations cannot change an engine result.
site.missionIntro: Our mission is to make the potential of food by-products easier to explore — responsibly, transparently, and with local ingredient opportunities in mind.
site.missionQuote: A by-product is not the end of a food story. With the right questions and evidence, it could be the beginning of another.
site.missionQuoteCaption: THE IDEA AT THE HEART OF UPCYCLE COMPASS
site.commitment1Description: Help processors and innovators explore materials already present in their supply chains, alongside a comparison with imported pea protein.
site.commitment2Description: Make safety gates and missing tests visible. A treatment suggestion never substitutes for a safety result or regulatory confirmation.
site.commitment3Description: Show ranges, evidence quality, transferred assumptions, and the conditions that could change a verdict.
site.commitment4Description: Use laboratory results to update an analysis and turn a working hypothesis into a better-informed next decision.
site.roadmapDescription: This is our intended direction, not a claim of completed impact. The prototype is a starting point; validation and partnerships come next.
site.roadmap1Description: Sample materials, transparent evidence labels, treatment comparisons, and a clear next test.
site.roadmap2Title: Learn with a mill and a brand
site.roadmap2Description: Seek pilot collaborators and compare model assumptions with real batch and laboratory evidence.
site.roadmap3Title: Build on what the evidence supports
site.roadmap3Description: Improve the data, refine the model, and expand language access as the work matures.
site.howIntro: The Compass helps you explore a material and an intended use. Start with a sample, inspect the reasoning, and understand what needs testing before going further.

tour.verdict: Go, No-go, or Test-first — with the reasons, evidence grade, and conditions that could change the answer.
tour.diagnosis: See which compounds or properties stand in the way of the intended use.
tour.chains: Explore supported candidate treatments, evidence gaps, and validation needs.
tour.cost: Compare protein costs with imported pea isolate and explore changing price assumptions.
tour.next: Find a recommended lab test, a readiness assessment, and a validation plan.
tour.memo: Take a printable decision memo with sources, assumptions, and limitations.

site.faq1Question: Do I need my own lab results to try it?
site.faq1Answer: No. Start with one of the sample presets. For your own batch, leave unknown fields blank rather than inventing measurements. The Compass labels defaults and evidence gaps.
site.faq2Answer: The available evidence does not yet support a confident decision for that batch and use. Review the safety gates and recommended next test to understand what is missing.
site.faq3Answer: The deterministic engine makes the calculations and verdict. Optional AI rewords the output; its numbers are checked against the engine result. A template is available when AI is not configured.
site.faq4Question: Can I use this as food-safety approval?
site.faq4Answer: No. This is a proof of concept for decision support. It does not replace laboratory validation, regulatory confirmation, or professional assessment.
site.footerDescription: A clearer path from food by-products to ingredient possibilities.
site.footerDisclaimer: Proof of concept. Decision support only. Not regulatory approval or a substitute for laboratory validation.
site.footerMade: Built with curiosity. Grounded in evidence.

input.summary: Pick a preset or describe your batch. Every field you leave empty uses a labelled dataset default.
input.equipment: Available equipment (leave all unticked if not known)
input.batchHint: Add the laboratory method and report reference for measured inputs. Without them, entered numbers remain scenario assumptions; they cannot clear safety gates.
input.completenessText: {{filled}} of {{total}} dataset values filled; {{ab}} graded A/B

errors.aflatoxinTotal: Total aflatoxins cannot be less than aflatoxin B1.
errors.proteinKg: Enter protein mass above 0 and at most 1 kg/kg finished product.

input.peaResearch: Pea research reference · 80.2% protein. The study explores gellan gum and salt for functional performance. Purchase price comes from the shared market model, because the paper reports no price.
input.contaminantHint: Enter the quantitative results from the batch report. Blank results require testing. µg/kg = ppb; mg/kg = ppm. Arsenic means total arsenic.

diagnosis.title: Diagnosis

chains.summary: Compare evidence-linked research candidates. Missing batch, yield or process evidence remains not estimated; the table is not a validated ranking.
chains.title: Treatment chains

chains.costMissing: Cost components missing (cost is a lower bound)

chains.paretoNone: Pareto ranking is unavailable without comparable, calculable costs, retention and supported success estimates.

cost.summary: Compare calculable ingredient costs with the shared landed pea-isolate scenario, using explicit protein and cost boundaries.
cost.title: Cost vs imported pea isolate
cost.lowerBound: Lower bound: some cost components have no data yet
cost.notComputable: Cost per kg recovered protein is not estimated: compatible batch protein/basis, recovery or purchase/process inputs are missing.
cost.chartSummary: Ours {{ours}} vs pea {{pea}} per kg protein (P50).
cost.allocationNote: Bar segments are an illustrative allocation using median inputs; the total matches the modelled median cost.
cost.sharedBenchmark: Shared pea benchmark, per kg of isolate (different from per kg of protein):

next.noTest: No optional economic test ranking is available.
next.upperBound: upper bound (assay CV unknown, perfect test assumed)

next.evppiTitle: Which uncertainty matters most (EVPPI, ₹ per decision)

memo.title: Decision memo
memo.notes: Numbers retain measured, published, assumed or synthetic provenance. References are not current-batch assays.
memo.noChain: No chain is ranked (a safety gate failed).

safety.title: Project contaminant limits
safety.policy: User-specified project acceptance thresholds, applied to every material and both market scenarios. These are not independently verified regulatory limits.
safety.units: µg/kg = ppb. mg/kg = ppm. Arsenic is total arsenic; the supplied 0.5 limit is interpreted as mg/kg.

workflow.legend: Measured = entered batch/lab result · Published = source reference · Assumption = scenario input · Demo data = synthetic example. Click a number for evidence; references are not batch measurements.
workflow.ratioMissing: No valid level-to-threshold ratio is available. A compatible batch result and a justified positive threshold are required; missing evidence is not a zero bar.
workflow.referenceWarning: Literature ranges below are reference information, not measurements of this lot. Unspecified route, method or basis requires verification.
workflow.regulatoryReference: Qualified regulatory category / intended-use review reference
workflow.confirmParsed: I have reviewed the parsed material, extraction route, lot and critical numbers before analysing.
workflow.costBoundary: Production cost uses recovered protein mass. Missing logistics, preprocessing, separation/drying, QA, packaging and waste costs remain excluded and explicitly unresolved; a partial cost is not full production cost.
workflow.marginFormula: Discount-adjusted benchmark difference = landed pea cost/kg protein × (1 − buyer discount) − our cost/kg recovered protein. It is a scenario difference, not validated profit; draw-by-draw medians need not equal the difference of two displayed medians.
workflow.dutyBasis: Import scenario basis and tax treatment
workflow.dutyExplanation: Illustrative 43.96% cash-import scenario: BCD 20% + assumed surcharge 2% + IGST 18% on 122% of the stated customs base. The 22% economic-cost scenario assumes full IGST credit. The alternative 49.15% source remains unverified. Classification, freight/tax bases, effective date and credit eligibility require a dated qualified review; these are not universal applicable rates.

costFormula.manual: Enter your own maximum acceptable ₹/kg recovered protein. Blank means no cost cap.
costFormula.benchmark: Suggested cap = landed benchmark ₹/kg isolate ÷ protein mass fraction × (1 − required discount). The benchmark is illustrative.
costFormula.product_budget: Suggested cap = allocated protein-ingredient budget ₹/kg finished product ÷ kg protein required/kg finished product.

workflow.functionalReference: Application-specific functional validation report / reviewer reference

functional.title: Extracted oilseed ingredient vs pea protein isolate
functional.compareHow: Conditions, evidence and next comparison test
functional.noWinner: These studies do not establish a head-to-head winner. Compare matched protein concentration, pH, salt, temperature, sample form and assay duration before calculating a difference.
functional.paper: Read Qi et al. (2025) · source paper

feedback.eyebrow: CLOSE THE LOOP · THIS ANALYSED CASE
feedback.title: How useful was this case?
feedback.scope: Feedback belongs to this exact analysis. Later matching cases use aggregate observations to suggest follow-up checks; feedback never overrides safety gates or verified laboratory evidence.
feedback.previous: {{count}} matching case(s) have feedback in the database.
feedback.liveRequired: Feedback needs a completed live analysis and an available database. Offline snapshots do not create or save case feedback.
feedback.saved: Feedback saved to this case. Matching future analyses will use the aggregate observations.

outcomes.failed: Did not work in my trial (unverified report)

feedback.privacy: Do not include personal or sensitive information. Notes are stored with this case; other cases receive aggregate counts and issue categories, not your notes. Trial reports remain unverified.
